findings: FogSet NULL calls GXSetFog and returns before GXSetFogRangeAdj; nonnull fog with no adjustment disables range adjustment.
FogLoadDesc dereferences desc after null-tolerant FogInit, so desc required; FogAdjLoadDesc allows null defaults.
FogAdjInit PSMTXCopy takes Mtx 3x4 so desc path only copies first three rows of Mtx44; fourth row remains existing. Defaults identity3x4 then explicitly sets fourth row.

FogRelease ref_DEC uses old count ==0 plus sentinel path; animation color and center float conversion not clamped. Header aobj offset comment0x3C conflicts with 64-byte Mtx44 at0x0C, so declaration authoritative.
